title: Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific SEO Template
text:
## Hiding Banner Ads On a Specific SEO Template
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000054639

## Steps
Navigate to My Content > SEO Templates .
Select the SEO template that contains the ad to be hidden, then click Edit .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184790304/original/H_LmzSYoTlFV7bp5cx__sStsi-sEq2hdDw.png?1788770035 | alt: ]
Click the Page Options tab.
Select Hide Banner Ad Modules .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184790345/original/HBprCPsF0xgZ115akJ6NeZNmiYwZDYWmzg.png?1788770071 | alt: ]
